name: trade
description: Two-sided player trade window — the default interface for exchanging items AND credits safely. `trade <player>` opens a shared two-panel window; each side stakes items/credits, any change unlocks both sides (anti-scam), and the atomic swap only happens once BOTH lock in. Buttons drive the same `tradeoffer`/`traderetract`/`tradeready` commands you can also type. Every state change now also writes the offers to the LOG — staking, retracting, locking and unlocking were silent, so a closed window left no trace of what was agreed. At the bottom Display Mode rung no panel is sent at all and the log IS the trade window.

trade.note: `trade status` (aliases check/show) re-reads both offers on demand, for EVERY player and not just text rungs: the anti-scam rule (any change unlocks both sides) is only a protection if you can check what you are locking in against, and a few lines of combat spam lose the panel history too.
